summary: The transfer account closed out cleanly with two runs of its isolating receipt and both knowledge entries reissued at revision 12, so I moved to the next thinnest surface in the submission: the VerifyLeader question, whose central pair of receipts each ran exactly once. The trigger where the leader answers a bounded self-verification with success despite reaching fewer voters than its quorum, and the lease control beside it, are the observations that whole account rests on, and a single execution is the one thing a reviewer can fairly discount. I therefore requested a repeat of 2fd5794c550141f7889f1530295d1294-experiment from its retained inputs, which reruns the same cases, admissions and assertions with no code change. An unchanged outcome gives that defect observation a second execution and leaves every conclusion, counterevidence item and limitation as recorded; a changed one would directly reopen the account's explanation that non-voter stream acknowledgements satisfy the voter quorum. The request validates against the schema and carries no other edits.
